description_ru: Пациент с болью в горле приходит на приём. Диалог о здоровье и советах врача.
text:
Doctor: Good afternoon, Mr Brown. What is the problem?
Mr Brown: I have a terrible sore throat, and I feel tired.
Doctor: How long have you felt like this?
Mr Brown: Since Monday. Yesterday I also had a headache.
Doctor: Do you have a fever? Let me check. Open your mouth, please.
Mr Brown: Ahh.
Doctor: Your throat is red, but it is not serious. You have a cold.
Mr Brown: Do I need medicine?
Doctor: Not really. You must drink hot water with honey and rest for three days.
Mr Brown: Can I go to work tomorrow?
Doctor: No, it is better to stay at home. You will feel stronger on Friday.
Mr Brown: Thank you, doctor. I feel better already.
Doctor: Good. Call me if you are worse.
Mr Brown: I promise. My wife is going to make chicken soup tonight, so I will be fine.

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Кончик языка слегка между зубами, выдыхайте воздух без голоса; не заменяйте на «с» или «ф».
Кончик языка поднят и не касается нёба, губы чуть округлены; не раскатистое русское «р».
Выдыхайте воздух из горла мягко, как на холодное стекло; не русское «х».

questions.question: What is wrong with Mr Brown?
What does the doctor say he has?
How many days must he rest?
